name: 2-slice toaster
description: The 2-slice toaster is a compact and convenient kitchen appliance designed for toasting two slices of bread at a time. It features adjustable browning settings, a cancel button, and a removable crumb tray for easy cleaning. The toaster is suitable for various types of bread and offers a quick and efficient toasting experience. Its sleek and simple design makes it a versatile addition to any kitchen countertop.

name: 4-slice toaster

Its sleek appearance and easy-to-use features make it a convenient addition to any kitchen.

description: The smart toaster is a modern kitchen appliance designed to efficiently toast bread and other baked goods. Overall, the smart toaster offers convenience and functionality for everyday use.
